label: GitHub
description: Work with GitHub repositories over the REST API: issues, labels, branches, users, search, and gists.
notes: Skipped create-issue and create-comment-on-a-issue: live catalog nodes github.createIssue and github.createComment already cover them equally (labels/assignees on create-issue are optional typed arrays that templates cannot emit, so a transpile would not be richer). find-issue simplified to a general searchIssues node taking a raw GitHub search query instead of piece-side query-string assembly. create-branch simplified to a single request: caller supplies the source commit SHA (chain github.findBranch) and a fully qualified ref, since the piece's branch-name-to-SHA lookup is a second request. add-labels-to-issue simplified to one label per call because a JSON array cannot be built from a string config value; the single element is JSON-encoded inside a static array literal. create-gist re-emitted with replaces: the live node interpolates raw {{config.public}} into the JSON body and has a reversed outputMap entry; this version uses a true/false select JSON-encoded as a string, which the gists API documentedly accepts (public is boolean-or-string), and fixes the mapping. Dropped optional lock_reason/thread-style keys everywhere the API rejects empty strings. needsPieceRuntime: create-pull-request-review-comment (required integer position — API needs a true JSON number), create-discussion-comment (assembles a GraphQL mutation by string interpolation and passes a discussion number where the API wants a node ID), update-issue (conditional inclusion of seven optional fields incl. typed arrays and a numeric milestone). lock-issue, unlock-issue, create-commit-comment, and raw-graphql-query (without its optional typed variables object) are transpilable but omitted due to the 8-action cap. GitHub App auth (JWT signing + installation-token exchange) is not expressible in the HTTP runtime; nodes use a plain bearer token.
